value.title: Reviewer packet — plan 133 rs tap supersedes legacy

sections.name: mission
sections.value: You are the cross-model reviewer for plan 133-rs-tap-supersedes-legacy. The composed Rust implementation is complete on branch 133-rs-tap-supersedes-legacy. Judge whether the code makes AC1-AC6 true, especially the tmux ownership and delivery-queue composition seams. You are read-only on code.

value.text: Orient: read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md, assets/tasks/phase-1/tasks.dd.md, assets/live-proof.md, and the full branch diff against main. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: use flowspace3 search for meaning-shaped review questions and report misses as friction.
Review with /builder review discipline. Run targeted tests yourself and re-derive behavior; do not trust PM receipts or prose.
Dispatcher lists follow: least-confidence, disbelieve, and known-open. Refuse to start if any is unclear.
Priority: false plan promises; composition seams; impl-guide interface drift; correctness/safety; missing contract tests. Ignore style noise.
At most material findings, each CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM with exact location, claim, proof, and smallest fix. no_material_findings is valid.
Write a ddoc review record under docs/plans/133-rs-tap-supersedes-legacy/assets/reviews/, build it, then send pij-payable-ferret the path and one-line verdict via pij tooling.

WHERE PM IS LEAST CONFIDENT: next_retry_at predicts the scheduler cadence rather than reading persisted jobs.not_before; legacy recognition uses injected ~/.pij/pane-signals file existence plus an empty marker; audit every DeliveryOutcome::Queued constructor and match after the enum cutover.

DISBELIEVE THE AUTHOR: independently inspect every changed code path and re-run the smallest tests that could falsify AC1, AC3, AC4, and AC6. Treat assets/live-proof.md as claims to verify against code, not authority.

KNOWN OPEN, DO NOT RE-REPORT: the 12-hour witness gap preceded destination admission and is sender-side/out of plan; Rust sensors are absent from harness checks and out of scope; production rs was intentionally not restarted; canary exposed a legacy/rs split identity for this reviewer, who must communicate and review under observable-derived rs id pij-obnoxious-primate.
The PM is your counterpart: verdict and findings go to the PM; the PM may refute findings with evidence — re-judge refutations on the evidence, not on rank.
You do not fix code, commit, or open PRs. If you find something outside the plan's scope, name it as a note for prime rather than expanding the review.

value.fence: read-only on code; write only assets/reviews/ in the plan folder
value.forbidden_note: No code edits, no merges, no government files, no production daemon restart.

value.text: Every plan AC judged true/false with evidence cited.
Composition seams between units explicitly examined and reported.
Review record ddoc written, built, and path delivered to the PM with a verdict line.

value.note: PM evidence to disbelieve and re-derive
